_comment: All seamed-slice knobs are configurable — drop this file as --config or merge into manifest/project/editions. Copy to core/layouts.json to override N layouts, or pass via CLI.

slice._note: width/height in (0,1), area <1 so no source ever reveals its full frame; x/y are deterministic random per loop per period via sha256-counter-v1

seam._note: width in (0,0.15] fraction of canvas; mode blur|feather|morph; sigma in (0,0.1] fraction of min(width,height) for boxblur radius

N.note: Each count has authored portrait+landscape pair in core/artifact001_layouts.py — override via core/layouts.json or examples/layouts.json

cli.state_override: python3 core/render_triptych.py --state runtime-proof/state-2.json --orientation portrait --slice-width 0.4 --seam-mode morph --config examples/slice-seam-config.json
